summary: Iter43 — Final E2E verification of Field Leadership module after FieldLeadershipHub.jsx rewrite to SectionCard pattern. Backend: 28/28 pytest pass (test_field_leadership_iter42.py reused) — auth (login wrong/right, /check leadership+admin+PM), reference data, all 10 record kinds POST/list/filter/get/PDF/CSV, Supervisor Notes admin-only gate, PDF magic bytes + ForgedOps footer + 'Judd Group' absence, AND test_pm_scoping NOW PASSES (the iter42 critical PM token bug has been fixed in server.py wiring). Frontend (Playwright): /leadership renders password gate, MASCIGC unlocks → 'Access granted' toast → 10 /leadership/* tiles + 1 Safety Equipment external tile + 'Admin Only' badge on Supervisor Notes + Records/Sign Out/Company Info/EN-ES toggle in slate-900 header matching Hub.jsx baseline. Write-Up form (`/leadership/write_up/new`) renders 15 inputs (Active Job, Employee picker w/ Add new, Position, Supervisor, Date/Time, Location, Category, Severity, Description). Records dashboard (`/leadership/records`) loads with 33 records, count tiles for Total + 10 kinds, filters (Employee/Job/Supervisor/date_from/date_to/q), Search + Clear + Export CSV. Wrong-password attempt returns backend 401 (visual feedback present in screenshot but not captured by .error selector — minor).
action_items:
Optional: stop-the-noise — wrong-password feedback on /leadership relies on a sonner toast that disappears in ~1.5s and isn't styled with .error/[role=alert]. If you want stable Playwright assertions, add data-testid='leadership-gate-error' to the toast (or to a persistent inline error

) and use it instead of relying on aria-live. Functional behavior is correct (401 emitted, retry available, MASCIGC unlocks).
critical_code_review_comments: FieldLeadershipHub.jsx — visual parity with Hub.jsx is achieved (slate-900 header, MasciLogo, LangToggle, CompanyInfoDialog, Records/SignOut buttons, SectionCard tiles). No regressions observed on /pm or /admin headers from the shared SectionCard component.

routes/field_leadership.py + server.py — get_pm_user is now wired correctly (test_pm_scoping passes). The earlier defensive `if get_pm_user is not None` branch in _is_authed is no longer dead code. Recommend dropping the optional kwarg fallback in a future refactor and asserting at attach_routes time so a future regression surfaces immediately.
field_leadership_pdf.py — PDF asserts 'MASCI HUB' + 'ForgedOps' + '2026' present and 'Judd Group' absent (verified via pypdf text extraction in test_pdf_bytes_and_footer). ForgedOps rebrand is clean.

ALL_KINDS supervisor_notes guard works: leadership token → 403, admin token → 200, and list endpoint correctly filters supervisor_notes out for non-admin actors. The iter42 review comment about ?kind=supervisor_notes leak should still be re-checked in a future round but no exploit was reproducible in this test.
AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false confirmed in /app/backend/.env — submissions persist + PDFs generate without firing Resend. Production deploy must flip this to true.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (gate, hub render, form render, records dashboard)

test_credentials: Field Leadership: MASCIGC ✓. Admin: MASCI1982! ✓. PM: chriswright@mascigc.com / ChrisRocksThis2026 ✓ (PM auth on /api/field-leadership/check now returns 200 role=pm).
seed_data_creation: Re-used iter42 seed (TEST-FL-001 / TEST_FL_Sub_Employee). Iter43 added ~15 more TEST_FL_* records via the regression run. Cleanup not performed — admin can soft-delete via /api/field-leadership/{id} or filter by employee_name prefix TEST_FL_/TEST_DEL_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_field_leadership_iter42.py is the canonical regression for this module — 28 tests covering all 10 form kinds + auth (leadership/admin/PM) + supervisor-notes admin gate + PDF/CSV. PM scoping is now wired and tested. If you add new form kinds, append to ALL_KINDS in the test and add a schema entry in /app/frontend/src/lib/fieldLeadershipSchemas.js. Frontend has data-testid coverage on hub-section-leadership and 10/10 tiles render via SectionCard — but Records-page count tiles + filter inputs + record-row PDF/view links still lack data-testids (carried forward from iter42 minor item — non-blocking for this release).
rca of the issue: No new critical issues. Iter42's PM-token rejection bug is RESOLVED — get_pm_user dependency is now passed into attach_routes (verified via test_pm_scoping returning 200 + filtered list). PDF rebrand to ForgedOps is correct (string-level + extracted-text level assertions both pass). The Field Leadership module is functionally ready for deploy; only cosmetic enhancements (data-testids on records page, persistent inline error on gate) remain.
